interactions.flavorLineOne:
"Eva has outdone herself this year to make sure the Games are an event to remember. Perform well, and you'll win the right to light the ceremonial torches in the Tower. Along with a year's worth of bragging rights, as Eva would like me to remind you."

"There is a new challenge for you to overcome: Rushdown. Here's what you need to know." Zavala hands you a missive that reads:

RUSHDOWN
• Guardians are tasked with defeating 5 powerful combatants before the timer runs out.
• Each combatant defeated will increase the difficulty of combat.
• Guardians earn points by progressing quickly to reach higher score thresholds.
• Each day, there is a new combination of 5 powerful combatants to overcome.

Never a dull moment for the Vanguard. While Zavala orchestrates regular operations across the system and directs the fight to keep our hold on the Moon, he trusts you and Ikora to tackle the Vex crisis head-on.

headerDisplayProperties.description: Speak with Zavala about the emerging Vex crisis on the Moon.
headerDisplayProperties.name: The Vex Offensive

interactions.flavorLineOne:
The perpetually concerned look on Zavala's face lifts briefly as you approach.

"I see that your recent victories haven't dulled your edge. You're still pushing yourself to get better every day—an example I hope our New Lights follow."

"It's easy lose ourselves in the heady cosmic concerns that threaten the City, but in the heat of battle, a Guardian is only as good as their training."

He nods appreciatively at your battle-worn armor. "And I rest easy knowing that nobody trains harder than you."

Zavala looks exhausted, but alert. He hails you warmly as you approach.

"It's important that everyone in the Tower sees you training so fiercely. Your legend now exceeds even my own. Everyone looks up to you - both civilians and Lightbearers alike."

"You may not be a member of the Vanguard, but you set the tone for the Tower. Your work in the field is the realization of all of our efforts, right down to the sweeper bots."

"Thank you for taking your role, and our safety, as seriously as you do."

Zavala is amazed by your continuing ability to do the impossible. On behalf of the City, he thanks you for saving Saint-14. He also asks that you help Saint-14 adjust to his new life in the Tower however you can. He expects his return to the City will be a little overwhelming.

headerDisplayProperties.description: Commander Zavala has heard of your success in saving Saint-14 from the Infinite Forest and wishes to thank you. Visit him in the Tower Courtyard.
headerDisplayProperties.name: Zavala

interactions.flavorLineOne: Zavala is grateful that you defeated Kridis, but he now has other concerns. He believes that any compromise regarding the Darkness will only lead to disaster. Now that Eramis and her council are defeated, Guardians must no longer wield the Darkness. He hopes you'll respect this decision and help defend it. The people of the Last City need you now more than ever.

Now that Eramis is defeated, the Vanguard hopes to reclaim Europa for humanity. Zavala asks your help in destabilizing what remains of House Salvation. He informs you that Variks will help guide you through your first mission: sabotaging a Fallen weapons factory on Europa.

Return to Variks on Europa for more details.

"Congratulations on your performance in this year's Guardian Games. You should be proud of your accomplishments, regardless of the outcome. It's time to honor all of our classes and celebrate their achievements. Visit the podium to see the results of this year's competition." —Commander Zavala
Zavala's expression is unreadable as he accepts the cookies, but he nods in recognition of the thoughtful gift.

No need to waver, Guardian. The Vanguard stands behind you every step of the way.

The Light is our strength. The Darkness will never take that from us. 

Fight on.

"Riskrunner suits you, Guardian. I had planned to add it to the Tower's vault, but based on your performance, I think the only suitable place for it is in your hands.

"Weapons like this are the backbone of our arsenal. As you continue your journey, you would be wise to seek out other remarkable assets.

"Only by combining our Light with the most powerful of armaments can we hope to succeed against the enemies of humanity. Remember that, Guardian."
Zavala has called us to answer for our actions, but he seems reluctant to restrict your off-world activities.

"Exemplary work, Guardian. Strikes are an important component in our defense of humanity. As of now, I'm approving you for our full range of strike protocols; we're always in need of more fireteams ready to take the fight to the enemy's door."

Zavala holds one hand against the other palm.

"Now it's time for you to commemorate your success. You're ready for the next Guardian Rank. The ceremony starts at the tree behind you."

Zavala smiles.

"Don't delay."

Zavala's gaze is weighty, a mixture of pride, worry, and hope.

"Congratulations on reaching the second Guardian Rank. If you ever lack clarity on what to do next, the Ranks offer constructive guidance."

"There are two important tasks ahead of you. First, the superconducter. Completed analysis tells us it's exactly what we hoped for. We believe it can be used to reconstruct a powerful Arc weapon; a salvaged piece of Golden Age technology."

"Ikora Rey led the research efforts; she'll brief you on the specifics."

"We stand alongside more friends than ever before." The Humans of Neomuna are just as much included in that as those of the Last City. They have stood fast on the front lines of this conflict, and because of them, the Last City has been saved from more violence at its doorstep.

It isn't everything, but that thin line has made a huge difference.

"Now, I look up and see the hope we've built for ourselves." There is a gentle awe in the way Zavala regards the sky: the fleets of ships, the symbols of allies of the Last City. The Vanguard is no longer one last bastion against the Witness, but one of many.

Even without the Traveler, we are not alone.

And we'll need all the allies we can get. This war is far from over. Ikora has been in contact with Osiris regarding the mysteries yet unsolved. Visit her to learn more.
